display.purpose: Public hero and major campaign headlines.

body.purpose: Commerce copy, form labels, navigation, and operational content.

shadows.name: marketplace-lift
shadows.purpose: Subtle product and cart affordance lift.

motion.name: image-hover
motion.purpose: Small product and campaign image scale changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-confidence action used for checkout, submit, and primary navigation commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-base-action-value); color: #fff; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-outfit); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; transition: background 160ms ease, outline-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-base-action-hover-value); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-deep-value); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined alternative action that preserves the green market identity.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--color-deep-value); min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-deep-value); border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-outfit); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; transition: background 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent-value) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-deep-value); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Compact white form control with explicit focus and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-value); border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: var(--color-ink-value); font-family: var(--font-outfit); font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-deep-value); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-accent-value); } .ds-field:disabled { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); opacity: .6; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat bordered surface for grouped information and operational content.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-value); border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: var(--color-ink-value); font-family: var(--font-outfit); } .ds-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--color-muted-value); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact semantic status indicator for orders, delivery, and operational state.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-accent-value); color: var(--color-deep-value); font-family: var(--font-outfit); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Section Navigation
components.description: Quiet navigation item with stronger active text and tonal hover treatment.
components.html: MarketplaceOrders
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--font-outfit); } .ds-nav-link { display: block; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--color-muted-value); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link-active { background: rgba(255,255,255,.8); color: var(--color-ink-value); }

narrative.overview:
Freshmarkets should feel like a well-run public market brought into a premium digital service: local, fresh, direct, and easy to trust. The interface uses Carbon's market-green identity with clear neutral surfaces, purposeful produce imagery, and strong but practical typography. Value is communicated through clarity and confidence, not discount-store decoration.

The system is soft and layered. Customer surfaces can breathe and use imagery for discovery; admin and delivery surfaces stay denser so operators can scan queues and complete tasks. The same visual family must still be recognizable across both modes through shared tokens, controls, focus treatment, and status language.
keyCharacteristics: Modern public-market character with local, trustworthy warmth.
Soft tonal layering with restrained borders and stateful depth.
Strong Outfit typography and concise uppercase metadata.
Customer discovery balanced with operational clarity.

rules.name: The Rarity of Accent Rule
rules.body: Lime, coral, and sun should signal meaning. They should not become a full-screen decorative wash when a neutral surface communicates the task more clearly.

rules.name: The One Type Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep Outfit as the shared family. Create hierarchy through size, weight, line height, and spacing rather than introducing a second display face.

rules.name: The Layered Surface Rule
rules.body: Use a surface color change or a quiet border before adding a shadow; depth should explain hierarchy, not decorate every container.

dos: Do use semantic token names and shared UI primitives before adding route-level styles.
Do make market value visible through clear prices, units, availability, and delivery context.
Do preserve the difference between customer discovery density and operator task density.
Do use soft tonal layering and restrained shadows for hierarchy.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand voice or token family without an explicit product decision.
Don't turn every section into a rounded floating card or nest cards inside cards.
Don't use decorative gradients, generic AI dashboard motifs, or unsupported savings claims.
Don't make operational screens as spacious or promotional as the storefront.
